nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token contract address held by the timelock, assigned from the token_ constructor argument.
Immutable address of the beneficiary that receives released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp (truncated to a day boundary) of the release period.

Total token benefit that the beneficiary is entitled to; reduced by terminate().

Boolean flag set to true by terminate(); checked by the isNotTerminated modifier.
Constant 86400 seconds used for day-based release computation.
Private owner address maintained by the Ownable base contract.

View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the total benefit.

View function returning _totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().

Owner-only termination: freezes released amount, ends the schedule, and sweeps remaining tokens to the owner.
Returns the current owner address stored in _owner.
Owner-only function setting the owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to newOwner (nonzero).
Internal helper that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Internal view returning msg.sender.

Modifier requiring _isTerminated == false.

Library helper increasing an existing allowance.

Library function that forwards native value to a payable recipient using a low-level call.
Library function performing a low-level call with value to a target contract.
Library view using EXTCODESIZE to test whether an address is a contract.
Private helper that bubbles up revert reasons from a failed low-level call.
Library function performing a low-level staticcall to a target contract.
Library function performing a low-level delegatecall to a target contract.
Caller-controlled address reaching the contract through _msgSender() and the onlyOwner check.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving release math, the constructor require and terminate().

Low-level target.staticcall(data) invocation.
Low-level target.delegatecall(data) executing untrusted code in this contract's context.
External token().safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) call performed from withdraw().
External token().safeTransfer(owner(), amountToWithdraw) call performed from terminate().
Arithmetic releaseStartTime_ -= (releaseStartTime_ % SECONDS_OF_A_DAY) truncating the start to a day boundary.
Arithmetic daysOfTimelock_ * SECONDS_OF_A_DAY computing the release end offset.

Arithmetic amountToWithdraw = balanceOf(this) - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance) computing the owner sweep amount.
Unchecked arithmetic oldAllowance - value inside safeDecreaseAllowance.
Arithmetic allowance + value computing the new allowance inside safeIncreaseAllowance.
External high-level call address(token).functionCall(data, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed") to the token contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is only meaningful within the constructor that stores it into _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is only meaningful within the constructor that stores it into _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is normalized and consumed entirely by the constructor.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ is consumed entirely by the constructor release math.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is consumed entirely by the constructor.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter is validated and forwarded by transferOwnership.
_setOwner newOwner parameter is directly written into _owner by _setOwner.
isContract account parameter is only read by isContract.
sendValue recipient parameter is only used by sendValue.
sendValue amount parameter is only used by sendValue.
SafeERC20 token parameter is the target instance handled by the safe transfer helpers.
safeTransfer to parameter is the payout recipient within safeTransfer.
safeTransfer value parameter is the transferred amount within safeTransfer.
safeTransferFrom from parameter is only used by safeTransferFrom.
spender parameter is the allowance grantee handled by the approve helpers.
functionCallWithValue target parameter is the low-level call destination.
functionCallWithValue data parameter is the low-level call payload.
functionCallWithValue errorMessage parameter is the revert fallback used by that call path.

terminate amountToWithdraw local is created and consumed inside terminate.
releasedBalance passedDays local is computed and used only in releasedBalance.
releasedBalance totalDays local is computed and used only in releasedBalance.
isContract size local holds the EXTCODESIZE result inside isContract.
_setOwner oldOwner local caches the prior owner inside _setOwner.
safeIncreaseAllowance newAllowance local feeds the approve call in that helper.
safeDecreaseAllowance oldAllowance local feeds the unchecked subtraction in that helper.
